ios.desc:
Rate your days like episodes of your life — then discover what actually makes your life better.

Rated Days turns your daily life into a story you can understand.

Give each day a score, add notes, photos, people, places and tags, then watch your life turn into patterns, seasons, characters, memories and insights.

RATE YOUR LIFE
Every day becomes an episode.

• Rate each day from 0–10
• Add a title, notes and photos
• Track people, places and custom tags
• See your entire year as a color-coded grid
• Build a searchable history of your life

UNDERSTAND YOUR LIFE
Rated Days goes beyond journaling.

See patterns across the things you do, the people you spend time with and the places you go.

• Discover which habits are associated with better days
• See how tags like exercise, travel, sleep or alcohol relate to your ratings
• Compare your best and worst days
• Find your strongest streaks and toughest stretches
• See averages by weekday, month and season
• Explore your rating distribution over time

SEE THE PEOPLE IN YOUR STORY
Your life has recurring characters.

Rated Days helps you understand who appears in your best days and how those relationships evolve over time.

• Character rankings
• Appearance counts
• Average ratings with each person
• Character lifelines across your year

REMEMBER YOUR LIFE
Your memories become searchable.

Search by a person, place, word, tag or date and find days you would otherwise forget.

Rated Days keeps the context too — not just what happened, but how the day felt.

YOUR LIFE HAS SEASONS
Every month becomes a season.

See:
• Best episodes
• Worst episodes
• Season averages
• Top genres
• Recurring people
• Patterns across your month

THE NARRATOR’S CUT
Turn your real life into a story.

Rated Days can create weekly, seasonal and yearly recaps based on the days you actually lived.

See your:
• Best episode
• Worst episode
• Standout moments
• Recurring themes
• Important people
• Story of the week, month or year

DISCOVER YOUR LEVERS
Learn what tends to make your life better.

Rated Days can surface patterns such as:
• Activities associated with higher-rated days
• Things that may improve the following day
• Habits linked with better weeks
• Trade-offs that feel good now but cost you later

TURN INSIGHTS INTO ACTION
Set a Season Goal and track the commitments that support it.

Choose goals like:
• Get fitter
• Sleep better
• Drink less
• Eat healthier
• Improve focus
• Build stronger relationships
• Spend smarter
